env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# O0 passes -N -l and inlines nothing; O1 stays the upstream baseline
# and inlines a mid-size function; Os sets inline budget 15, which the
# same function must exceed [T-105]. The -d plumbing itself is not part
# of the contract.
cd o0test
logos build -a -x .
stderr '\-N \-l'
stderr 'variablemakethreshold=32'
logos build -a -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/o0$GOEXE .
! stderr 'inlining call to medium'
exec $WORK/o0$GOEXE
stdout '^-3$'
cd ..
cd o1test
logos build -a -x .
! stderr 'variablemakethreshold'
! stderr '\-N \-l'
logos build -a -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/o1$GOEXE .
stderr 'inlining call to medium'
exec $WORK/o1$GOEXE
stdout '^-3$'
cd ..
cd ostest
logos build -a -x .
! stderr 'variablemakethreshold'
logos build -a -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/os$GOEXE .
! stderr 'inlining call to medium'
exec $WORK/os$GOEXE
stdout '^-3$'
cd ..

-- o0test/go.mod --
module example.com/optlevels/o0test

go 1.27

-- o0test/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O0"

-- o0test/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func medium(x int) int {
	y := x + 7
	y = y*3 - x
	y ^= (x + 3) << 2
	y += y * x
	return y - (x * 5)
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(medium(3))
}

-- o1test/go.mod --
module example.com/optlevels/o1test

go 1.27

-- o1test/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O1"

-- o1test/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func medium(x int) int {
	y := x + 7
	y = y*3 - x
	y ^= (x + 3) << 2
	y += y * x
	return y - (x * 5)
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(medium(3))
}

-- ostest/go.mod --
module example.com/optlevels/ostest

go 1.27

-- ostest/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "Os"

-- ostest/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func medium(x int) int {
	y := x + 7
	y = y*3 - x
	y ^= (x + 3) << 2
	y += y * x
	return y - (x * 5)
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(medium(3))
}
